status: proposed physics contracts, not implemented API or completed resource preflight
baseline: fine_l6_e200; all 19 occupied radial orbitals, Z70 empirical Fermi nucleus, DC no-pair model with declared projector

stages.question: Can off-diagonal self-energy and orbital response materially change the retained scalar-Dyson spectrum?
stages.coverage: All same-kappa external matrix elements, two native second-order diagram classes, all occupied orbitals and complete declared virtual manifolds; no sign reconstruction from squared weights
stages.control: Native diagonal scalar replay in exactly the same metric and reference; independent small-space m-scheme anchor, phase covariance and Hermiticity
stages.outcome: Report every attachment, excitation and splitting shift. If response is small relative to retained 857-1636 cm-1 discrepancies, move to higher-order coverage rather than extending iterations. A large response still requires independent verification and full-space controls.
stages.stop: Any phase, metric, branch, denominator or resource-preflight failure; no automatic truncation or relaxed gate

stages.question: Do complete declared core and valence SD amplitudes improve all five attached states?
stages.implementation_options: Native atomic angular-coupled SD, or independently verified external implementation with a documented Hamiltonian/basis map
stages.model: 68-electron reference; valence attachment sectors; full declared core correlation and virtual range; no experimental rescaling
stages.controls: Separate matched second order, third order and all-order contributions; diagonal/matrix self-energy anchors; independent-method comparison and iterative amplitude residuals
stages.stop: Failed amplitude convergence, intruder-state identification, or memory/work estimate. Do not turn a scaffold call into a science result.
stages.resources: Estimate angular-coupled amplitude and integral storage before choosing a cap; none allocated in this review

stages.question: Does a balanced full/one-hole model improve energies and state properties together?
stages.first_audit: All roots of the retained 46-CSF frozen model, complete declared J/parity blocks, signed matrix couplings, diagonal root locations and continuous state weights; no old shifts pasted onto current Sigma
routes: 54-electron core + 15-valence-electron CI with complementary deep-core effective operators and subtraction diagrams if orbitals use a different potential
68-electron reference particle-hole CI+MBPT with explicit complementary P/Q partition
stages.coverage: 5s/5p response and g channels tested under successive explicit models; same nucleus/reference zero across lower and upper states
stages.anchor: P3 and its odd J=3/2 partner proximity, gap/order and properties, without experimental denominator/coupling fitting
stages.stop: Any P/Q overlap, unstable state identity, invalid orbital metric, or unbounded state-space allocation

stages.question: How large are native Coulomb-Breit cross terms after balanced correlation?
stages.control: Same orbitals, same states, same space, verified static Breit kernel, independent order/derivative anchor
stages.coverage: B1 separated from B2 and higher correlated response; frequency dependence separately declared
stages.stop: Mismatch of Gaunt/full-Breit or order conventions, double counting or failed derivative/integral anchor
